# Marble Skill Taxonomy attribution and Firstbot adaptation

Marble Skill Taxonomy (v1) · © Generative Spark, Inc. (Marble) · https://withmarble.com · licensed under ODbL 1.0 (database) and CC BY-SA 4.0 (content).

Source: https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy/tree/7bd8b6794cb78d9ca18216adb935f3cfd59cf5ac
Pinned commit: 7bd8b6794cb78d9ca18216adb935f3cfd59cf5ac

Unmodified upstream topics.json, clusters.json, manifest.json, topics/clusters schemas, README, PROVENANCE and both complete licenses are retained here. No upstream scripts or agent instructions were executed. Standards text and teaching-research data are not included in the application vendor directory. Topics retain upstream standard identifiers, not the text of those standards. See PROVENANCE.md for source-specific rights.

Firstbot filters the 1,845-topic database to the 576 actual Mathematics records. README's 571-maths subject table is stale at this pinned commit; actual data and manifest agree on 576. Native topic ageRangeStart and ageRangeEnd are approximate, inclusive guidance, NOT grade conversions, diagnosis, mastery, or a child's ability estimate. No derived grade-to-age mapping is needed or used.

Firstbot's capability mapping and filtered projection are adaptations offered under ODbL 1.0; adapted topic text under CC BY-SA 4.0. The complete source projection is reproducible from unmodified data and laptop/curriculum.py. No endorsement by Marble or curriculum publishers is implied. Firstbot-generated exercise mechanics are separate application logic. Child progress/settings are a separate private database, not contributions to the taxonomy.

Six deliberately narrow alignments: within-5 and within-10 addition/subtraction practice (not a fluency assessment); through-12 subset of Adding and subtracting; through-12 dots subset of Counting objects to 20; straight-side subset of 3-D shapes (age 5+) and 2-D shapes (age 6+). Exact upstream names and IDs are preserved, even where a title sounds broader than the implemented subset. No 3-D, symmetry, fractions, multiplication, division, word problems, advanced arithmetic, statistics or full curriculum coverage is implemented. Firmware/protocol bounds remain unchanged.
